documents.title: Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of The Board Meeting Held On October 30, 2026
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of EGM
Board Meeting Intimation for Meeting To Be Held On October 30, 2026
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Vadilal Industries reported FY19 consolidated revenue growth of 3%, or 13% adjusted for billing methodology changes, backed by 54% growth in its international business. The company experienced weakness in domestic sales during Q4 FY19 due to an extended winter, but started FY20 with double-digit growth in the summer season and 25% growth in international sales. Management expects double-digit overall growth with margin expansion in FY20 and plans regular capex of Rs. 30-35 crore. Due to elevated milk prices, the company will look to increase product prices in the second half of the year.

guidance.claim: Vadilal Industries expects regular capital expenditure of Rs. 30-35 crore during the year.
guidance.quote: We continue to incur regular capital expenditure and expect to spend Rs. 30-35 crore during the year.

guidance.claim: Management expects double digit growth with higher contribution from international business leading to margin expansion.
guidance.quote: We also expect to deliver double digit growth with higher contribution from international business leading to margin expansion.

guidance.claim: Vadilal Industries expects another good year in FY20 by leveraging its brand for ongoing growth.
guidance.quote: Going forward, we see another good year in FY20 as we leverage the Vadilal brand for ongoing growth.

guidance.claim: Vadilal Industries maintains a positive business outlook driven by an improved consumption environment, demand shift to the organized sector, and continued traction in international business.
guidance.quote: Going forward, we maintain our positive business outlook – better environment for consumption, demand shift to the organized sector and continued traction in international business.

guidance.claim: Management expects subdued raw material procurement prices for the next season to benefit company margins.
guidance.quote: We have been engaging with raw material suppliers for the next season and prices continue to be subdued, which should benefit margins.

demand_outlook.claim: Extended winter conditions until late March impacted ice cream consumption in core domestic markets in Q4 FY19.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic business saw weakness in Q4 due to exceptionally severe weather conditions that extended the winter till the end of March this year and impacted the consumption of ice cream in many of our core markets.

demand_outlook.claim: International revenues grew by 54% in FY19 to cross $20 million.
demand_outlook.quote: International revenues continued to deliver encouraging expansion to cross the $ 20 million milestone, on the back of 54% revenue growth during FY19.

demand_outlook.claim: FY20 started with double digit summer season growth and 25% revenue expansion in the international business.
demand_outlook.quote: We have started FY20 with double digit growth in the summer season and 25% revenue expansion in international business.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic business growth is reverting to historical trends after temporary impacts from changes in the operating environment and consumption spending.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic business growth, temporarily impacted by recent changes in operating environment and consumption spending, is now reverting to historical trends

demand_outlook.claim: Latent demand for quality Indian products is driving strong volume growth in US ice cream sales.
demand_outlook.quote: Latent demand for quality Indian products driving strong volume growth in US ice cream sales

demand_outlook.claim: Vadilal Industries expanded overall ice cream volumes by 6.9% in Q2 FY19, driven by 6% domestic volume growth and 37% expansion in international business.
demand_outlook.quote: During Q2, we have continued our strong business momentum to expand ice cream volumes by 6.9%, driven by 6% domestic volume growth and 37% expansion in the international business.

demand_outlook.claim: The international business experienced robust demand following distribution expansion and focused selling to the Indian diaspora in the US and other regions.
demand_outlook.quote: International business has witnessed robust demand as VIL expanded distribution and is selling products focused on Indian diaspora in the US and other geographies

capex_expansion.claim: Distribution investments have been committed across multiple US locations for market access to the Indian diaspora.
capex_expansion.quote: We have already committed distribution investments in multiple locations in the U.S. that allow us widespread access to the sizeable Indian diaspora in key target markets.

capex_expansion.claim: Vadilal estimated its capital expenditure for FY19 at approximately Rs. 35 crore.
capex_expansion.quote: Estimated capex for FY 19 at ~ Rs. 35 crore

capex_expansion.claim: No major capital expenditure is anticipated on capacity enhancement.
capex_expansion.quote: No major capital expenditure anticipated on capacity enhancement

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin expanded by over 600 basis points last year due to volume growth, benign raw material prices, and higher international contributions.
margins_costs.quote: Gross margin expanded by over 600 basis points last year on the back of volume growth, benign raw material prices and larger contribution from international operations, where realizations are significantly higher.

margins_costs.claim: People resource costs increased significantly last year, largely driven by US operations.
margins_costs.quote: Cost of people resources increased significantly last year, with a large contribution from U.S. operations that now have a base of over 50 employees.

margins_costs.claim: Vadilal has raw material purchase and inventory visibility covering stable costs till Q2.
margins_costs.quote: Based on our raw material purchase and inventory position, we have visibility of stable costs covered till Q2.

margins_costs.claim: The company will look to increase prices in the second half of the year due to higher milk prices.
margins_costs.quote: As milk prices are at higher levels now, we will look to increasing prices in the second half of the year.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax expanded from Rs. 15 crore to Rs. 40 crore in the first nine months of FY19.
margins_costs.quote: Flow down of these initiatives have resulted in profit after tax expanding from Rs. 15 crore to Rs. 40 crore in the first nine months of FY19.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin increased by over 600 bps to 44.4% and EBITDA margin expanded by over ~1,000 bps during Q2 FY19.
margins_costs.quote: Margins have improved significantly during the quarter – gross margin increased by over 600 bps to 44.4% and EBITDA margin by over ~1,000 bps.

margins_costs.claim: Margin improvements were achieved through volume growth, utilization of existing capacities, lower raw material procurement prices, and operating cost discipline.
margins_costs.quote: This is in line with the recent trend of expansion and has been achieved through volume growth by utilizing existing capacities, lower raw material procurement prices and operating cost discipline.

margins_costs.claim: International ice cream sales carry higher realizations and contribution margins, aiding overall profitability.
margins_costs.quote: International ice cream sales come with higher realizations and contribution margins, which is also helping improve profits while increasing utilization of current capacities.

orders_capacity.claim: Production capacity was expanded from 270,000 liters per day to 380,000 liters per day over past years.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity expanded from 270,000 liters per day to 380,000 liters per day over the past few years

orders_capacity.claim: No major capital expenditure is anticipated for capacity enhancement.
orders_capacity.quote: No major capital expenditure anticipated on capacity enhancement

orders_capacity.claim: Vadilal is present in 55,000 retail outlets across 26 states in India.
orders_capacity.quote: Currently, we are present in 55,000 retail outlets in 26 states across the country.

capital_allocation.claim: Vadilal reconstituted outstanding debt to increase long tenure loans and lower borrowing costs.
capital_allocation.quote: Reconstituted outstanding debt to increase long tenure loans and reduced cost of debt

capital_allocation.claim: Operating cash flow surplus will be used to rationalize debt and enhance working capital management.
capital_allocation.quote: Leveraging surplus generated by operations to rationalize/ restructure debt and improve working capital management

risks_headwinds.claim: An extended winter until late March affected ice cream consumption across core markets in Q4 FY19.
risks_headwinds.quote: Domestic business saw weakness in Q4 due to exceptionally severe weather conditions that extended the winter till the end of March this year and impacted the consumption of ice cream in many of our core markets.

risks_headwinds.claim: Higher milk price levels present a cost headwind for the company.
risks_headwinds.quote: As milk prices are at higher levels now, we will look to increasing prices in the second half of the year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Domestic business growth was temporarily impacted by changes in the operating environment and consumption spending.
risks_headwinds.quote: Domestic business growth, temporarily impacted by recent changes in operating environment and consumption spending, is now reverting to historical trends

management_commitments.claim: Vadilal expects to spend Rs. 30-35 crore on regular capital expenditure during the year.
management_commitments.quote: We continue to incur regular capital expenditure and expect to spend Rs. 30-35 crore during the year.

management_commitments.claim: Management will look to increase product prices in the second half of the year owing to higher milk prices.
management_commitments.quote: As milk prices are at higher levels now, we will look to increasing prices in the second half of the year.

management_commitments.claim: Vadilal expects another good year in FY20 by leveraging its brand for ongoing growth.
management_commitments.quote: Going forward, we see another good year in FY20 as we leverage the Vadilal brand for ongoing growth.

management_commitments.claim: Vadilal estimated capital expenditure for FY19 at approximately Rs. 35 crore.
management_commitments.quote: Estimated capex for FY 19 at ~ Rs. 35 crore
